label: Input right after an early u (step 1-2 of the original phase)
explanation: Fires only in the original (input) phase at steps 1-3, almost always on the token directly after a u (95% of activation mass has prev_tok = u; the rest has prev_tok = p). 96% of the mass is at t = 2, i.e. the third input with u as the second token. The largest activations (up to max) come from sequences starting "p u", and prev2 in {u, p} makes it stronger. When the first token is u (t = 1) it fires weakly and only some of the time. Precision is incomplete: many "X u Y" prefixes with other first tokens (w, y, l, e, ...) give no activation. Smaller parts: "u p Y", "p p Y", and "? u u Y" at t = 3. Never fires at t = 0, at t >= 4, on the delimiter, or in the copy phase. The current input token barely matters (x is a little higher).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=2 & prev_tok=u (+8.82), t=2 & prev_tok=p (+7.86), prev2_tok=p (+5.99), t=1 & in_tok=2 (+5.77), t=1 & in_tok=1 (+5.75), t=1 & in_tok=0 (+5.74). Lower it: prev2_tok=l (-5.49), prev2_tok=z (-4.85), orig_idx=-1 (-4.69), prev2_tok=y (-4.61).
